project_context.user_requirement: Design a single-page guild commission board. Put exactly three commission categories on the left, show exactly eight commission cards in a two-row grid in the center, keep selected commission details and an Accept Commission primary action on the right, and add a Refresh button. Do not reuse the reference shop copy, products, prices, characters, or castle/battle narrative.
project_context.game_context: A cooperative dark-fantasy RPG where guild members review and accept timed commissions.
constraints: Keep all functional text readable at 1920x1080.
Do not add pages or navigation not requested.
Use reference evidence as structure and style guidance, not as target content.

design_summary.target_experience: A single-screen guild workspace for filtering, comparing, inspecting, refreshing, and accepting commissions.
design_summary.synthesis_summary: Adapt the reference's left-navigation, dominant center-grid, and right-detail progression to a new guild commission workflow while replacing its original business semantics, counts, and primary-action meaning. Apply only reliable and relevant B2 dark-fantasy visual traits.
key_design_decisions: Use exactly three left-side category tabs because the user count overrides the five-tab reference.
Use exactly eight commission cards in a two-row grid because the user count overrides the six visible reference cards.
Replace the reference primary-action semantics with commission selection and acceptance.
Keep Refresh secondary and spatially separate from the Accept Commission action.
Keep the page self-contained with no invented navigation.

layout.source_meaning: Organize a left-to-right progression from category control through a dominant repeated collection to a contextual detail region.
layout.target_application: Use category navigation on the left, an eight-card commission grid in the center, and selected commission details on the right.
layout.rationale: The relationship is portable, but all shop content and reference counts are replaced by the user's commission workflow.

layout.source_meaning: A vertically repeated category-control group appears at the left edge.
layout.target_application: Create exactly three vertically stacked commission category tabs.
layout.rationale: The user explicitly requests three categories, overriding the five visible reference tabs.

layout.source_meaning: A repeated two-row grid is the dominant browsing region.
layout.target_application: Create exactly eight commission cards in a four-column by two-row grid.
layout.rationale: Preserve the grid organization while changing the visible count from six to the user-required eight.

layout.source_meaning: The primary action is contained within the contextual detail region.
layout.target_application: Place Accept Commission inside the selected commission detail panel and isolate it from Refresh.
layout.rationale: The containment and emphasis remain useful, but purchase semantics are rejected.

layout.source_meaning: A shallow top region carries global status separately from the main browse-detail workspace.
layout.target_application: Use a compact guild status header above the three-column workspace.
layout.rationale: Global guild context is useful without copying the reference currency content.

layout.source_meaning: Reference copy and currency icon design are not portable layout knowledge.
layout.rationale: The target uses original guild commission semantics and does not inherit product names, prices, or currency visuals.

style.target_application: Use low-saturation cool blue-gray and near-black as the page-wide base with silver-white information contrast.
style.rationale: This stable trait has diverse support and does not conflict with the user.

style.target_application: Express primary UI surfaces with silver-black hard-surface framing.
style.rationale: The stable material language is appropriate for a dark-fantasy guild interface.

style.target_application: Use restrained pointed corners and elongated control silhouettes.
style.rationale: The stable contour tendency can transfer without copying reference objects.

style.target_application: Use localized blue-white light for selection, status, and primary-action emphasis.
style.rationale: The trait is stable and works as functional emphasis.

style.target_application: Use matte dark bases on large panels while keeping text zones lighter and readable.
style.rationale: The secondary evidence is relevant to large guild-workspace surfaces but is not made global.

style.target_application: Limit sparse pointed caps and fine engraving to major framing areas.
style.rationale: Restrained use supports the page context without turning decoration into a global requirement.
The red evidence is tied to specific source content and has no matching target role.
B2 does not establish one rendering treatment, so Composer does not silently select a global approach.

style.target_application: Maintain an abstract dark-fantasy guild atmosphere through surface, color, and ornament language only.
style.rationale: The target game context matches this stable trait without importing source narrative objects.
The uncertain meaning of blue-white indicators cannot become a target-world fact.

visual_direction.summary: A cold, disciplined dark-fantasy guild interface with matte silver-black surfaces, sharp restrained geometry, and localized blue-white functional highlights. The style supports commission browsing without importing source characters, locations, products, or battle narrative.

directives.direction: Use low-saturation cool blue-gray and near-black for large fields, silver-white for readable information, and blue-white only for controlled functional emphasis.
notes: Do not globalize the local red trait.

directives.direction: Use silver-black hard-surface frames with matte dark interiors on major panels.
notes: Keep matte treatment subordinate to text readability.

directives.direction: Use elongated proportions and restrained pointed corners for tabs, cards, and the primary action.
Reserve localized blue-white rim or inset light for selected cards, active category state, and Accept Commission.
notes: Do not imply whether the light is magical or technological.

directives.direction: Confine sparse gothic engraving and pointed caps to the header and detail frame.
notes: This secondary trait is intentionally limited to major framing surfaces.

directives.direction: Express dark-fantasy context abstractly through palette, material, and ornament rather than literal reference scenes or characters.

hierarchy_emphasis: Commission grid is the primary browsing focal region.
Selected commission detail is the secondary information focal region.
Accept Commission is the dominant action; Refresh remains secondary.
Guild status header supports context without competing with the workspace.
page_specific_notes: Selected state must be legible without relying on red.
The three categories and eight commissions must remain countable at a glance.

pages.purpose: Filter, compare, inspect, refresh, and accept guild commissions on one screen.

states.description: Three categories and eight commissions are available, with one commission selected.
Commission content is temporarily updating while the page structure remains stable.
The selected commission acceptance action is being confirmed.

entry_conditions: The user opens the guild commission board.

component_tree.name: Guild Commission Board
component_tree.design_intent: Own the complete single-page guild commission experience.

component_tree.name: Guild Status Header
component_tree.design_intent: Provide compact guild identity and current commission-capacity context.
notes: Do not copy reference currency iconography.

component_tree.name: Commission Workspace
component_tree.design_intent: Coordinate left navigation, central browsing, and right detail regions.

component_tree.name: Commission Categories
component_tree.design_intent: Filter the visible commission set using exactly three categories.

component_tree.name: Category Tab
component_tree.design_intent: Represent one commission category with clear selected and unselected states.

repeat.content_variation: Each instance has a distinct category label and one instance is selected.

component_tree.name: Commission Browse Area
component_tree.design_intent: Hold the dominant repeated commission collection and its secondary refresh control.

component_tree.name: Commission Grid
component_tree.design_intent: Present exactly eight commissions in a stable two-row comparison grid.

component_tree.name: Commission Card
component_tree.design_intent: Summarize one commission and expose a clear selection state without performing acceptance.

repeat.content_variation: Each instance represents a distinct commission; exactly one may be selected.

notes: Use a four-column by two-row arrangement.

component_tree.name: Refresh Commissions
component_tree.design_intent: Refresh the commission set as a secondary action that cannot compete with acceptance.

component_tree.name: Selected Commission Detail
component_tree.design_intent: Explain the selected commission and contain its primary acceptance action.

component_tree.name: Commission Title
component_tree.design_intent: Identify the selected commission with the strongest text emphasis in the detail panel.

component_tree.name: Commission Requirements
component_tree.design_intent: Present concise eligibility, duration, and objective information in a readable block.

component_tree.name: Accept Commission
component_tree.design_intent: Act as the isolated primary CTA for the selected commission.
notes: Do not merge visually with Refresh.

content_adaptation: Keep functional children inside the safe area.

relationships.description: Remain above the main workspace without overlapping it.

content_adaptation: Collapse nonessential status decoration before reducing text legibility.

relationships.description: Fill the safe area below the status header.

content_adaptation: Preserve left-center-right order at landscape resolutions.

relationships.description: Remain left of the dominant commission browse area.
Align top and bottom rhythm with the browse area.

content_adaptation: Distribute exactly three tabs vertically with equal height and gaps.

relationships.description: Follow category navigation in the browse sequence.

content_adaptation: Arrange exactly eight cards as four columns by two rows.
Reserve a separate lower edge zone for Refresh without reducing the card count.

relationships.description: Use a stable four-column by two-row repeated structure inside the browse area.
Keep all eight cards above the secondary refresh control.

content_adaptation: Keep all eight cards visible simultaneously at the target resolution.
Use uniform card bounds so count and selection remain scannable.

relationships.description: Remain below and secondary to the repeated commission grid.
Maintain clear spatial separation from the primary action.

content_adaptation: Allow detail text to wrap without covering the primary action.
Keep the action anchored when content length changes.

relationships.description: Remain contained within the detail panel.
Follow selected commission information as the dominant action.

content_adaptation: Maintain a minimum clear band around the CTA.
Do not compress below a one-line readable label.

feedback: Refresh the eight-card content without changing grid count.
Move the selection highlight to the chosen card.
Show restrained progress feedback without replacing the page.
Return to ready with exactly eight cards.

conditions: A commission is selected and eligible.
feedback: Provide clear pressed and confirmation feedback.

must_include: One right selected commission detail panel.
One visually isolated Accept Commission action.
must_not_include: Reference shop product names, prices, purchase copy, or currency iconography.
Reference characters, castle scenery, battle scenes, or narrative events.
Additional pages, modal flows, or unrelated controls.
Global red styling derived from the B2 local red trait.

exact_counts.requirement: Render exactly eight commission cards in two rows.
Render exactly one primary Accept Commission action.
Render exactly one secondary Refresh action.

key_content_zones.requirement: Reserve readable space for guild identity and capacity status.
Keep title, status, and duration zones readable on every card.
Reserve a stable text block above the primary action.
Keep the full Accept Commission label unobstructed.

component_separability: Every commission card must have an identifiable outer boundary.
Category tabs must be individually separable.
Accept Commission and Refresh must read as distinct controls.
The detail panel must be separable from the grid for future asset production.
overlap_restrictions: No decoration may cover functional text.
No card may overlap another card or the detail panel.
The primary action must not overlap detail text.
The header must not overlap the workspace.
readability_requirements: Functional text must remain readable at 1920x1080.
Selected and unselected states must remain distinguishable without red.
Panel interiors must provide sufficient contrast for silver-white text.
clean_boundary_requirements: Major panels need clean continuous boundaries.
Repeated cards and tabs need consistent edge treatment.
Decorative caps and engraving must not break hit-area silhouettes.
cutout_friendly_requirements: Keep tabs, cards, primary CTA, and secondary CTA visually self-contained.
Avoid soft atmospheric effects crossing component boundaries.
Keep localized glow close to the component that owns it.
reference_fidelity_boundaries: Preserve A's abstract left-navigation, center-collection, right-detail organization only after adapting counts and semantics.
Use B2 palette, material, shape, lighting, and restrained decoration as visual language, not literal source objects.
Do not reproduce source branding, copy, characters, currency shapes, or scene narrative.
Do not choose a global rendering approach from B2's unresolved rendering conflict.

assumptions.statement: One commission is selected when the page first becomes ready.
assumptions.impact: The right detail panel has meaningful initial content.

assumptions.statement: Each card needs compact identity, status, and duration information to support comparison.
assumptions.impact: Cards reserve structured text zones but do not prescribe final copy.

warnings.message: The user-required three categories and eight cards override the reference's five visible tabs and six visible cards; the repeated organization is adapted rather than copied.
B2 reports conflicting semi-realistic and stylized interface rendering; no global rendering treatment is selected.
The meaning of blue-white indicators is uncertain, so the plan uses them only as functional emphasis and not as world narrative.
